purpose: Git-tracked configuration for separating repeat-case high-frequency white-floor drift from pre-ADC transfer drift

white_floor_profile.scale_reference: repeat detector snapshot post_filter_white_asd_A_rtHz after normal production white-fraction conversion

guardrail: The post-filter white floor is a diagnostic nuisance amplitude with unresolved absolute CH0 calibration. Improvement after profiling does not identify a physical white-noise source. The transfer refit is performed only after fixing the profiled white floor, so remaining transfer drift can be separated from high-frequency-floor leverage.
